abstract: Serum beta-HCG and urinary HCG were measured in 17 patients with histologically proved pure seminoma of the testis. The patients have been followed to date for 10 to 74 months after orchiectomy, and have no residual disease or recurrence of their disease. Preoperative urinary HCG levels were abnormal in 9 patients (53%). Serum beta-HCG levels were slightly elevated in 6 out of 12 patients evaluated, and were reduced after orchiectomy even in patients with preoperative normal beta-HCG levels (P less than 0.05). Preoperative levels of the tumour marker in seminoma were far lower than in patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours, but it would not be rare to see a small amount of HCG produced by the tumour cells in the seminoma.
abstract_ja: 病理組織学的に純粋なセミノーマと診断された精巣の患者17例について、血清β-hCGおよび尿中hCGを測定した。患者は精巣摘除術後10～74か月にわたりフォローアップされ、残存病変や再発は認められていない。術前の尿中hCG値は、9例（53%）で異常値であった。評価した12例のうち6例では、血清β-hCGがわずかに高値であった。術前に正常なβ-hCG値を示した患者でも、精巣摘除術後に血清β-hCGは低下した（P<0.05）。セミノーマにおける術前の腫瘍マーカー値は、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者に比べて著しく低いが、セミノーマ細胞が少量のhCGを産生することも珍しくない。
